lines.en: I drag my feet across your doorstep.

Chewing bones
Shuffling noise
Chomping flesh

lines.zh: 我踩着你的步伐，学着你的样子。
lines.en: I walk your steps, wearing your shape.
Slow movement sound
Scouring for a target
It walks in your rhythm.
Its steps lag half a beat behind yours.
Staring ahead
Empty gaze
Shaking dully

lines.zh: 我撕下这张脸，又贴回去。
lines.en: I peel this face off, then press it back on.
Half asleep
Slow blinking

lines.zh: 没有人在家，只有这层皮。
lines.en: Nobody's home—just this layer of skin.
Eyes wandering
Dull gaze
Fuzzy vision
I'll borrow this face for a while.
Whose face was this shaped after?
My face looks a lot like yours, right?
Chasing relentlessly
Moving towards player

lines.zh: 我穿着你的样子，笑得很像。
lines.en: I wear your shape and smile just like you.
Hunger in eyes
Fierce expression

lines.zh: 我喉咙里挤出你的声音。
lines.en: I squeeze your voice out of my throat.

lines.zh: 你的步子，我学得一模一样。
lines.en: I copy your stride exactly.
It wears the same clothes you do.
It copies the way you look at the sky.
Your outline sits on its face.
A piece of skin is torn, ouch!
A bone crackled, ouch!
Blood is flowing, ouch!
Muscle torn, ouch!
A tendon snapped, ouch!
A bone is broken, ouch!
Tendons and bones, ouch!
The wound is infected, ouch!
Decaying, ouch!
A wound splits open, ouch!
Rotten eyes on you!
You smell like a player!
Come closer, you won't survive!
Player taste good!

lines.zh: 你回头时，我会笑得很像。
lines.en: When you turn around, my smile will look just like yours.
Don't run, I'll catch you!
I'll trick you by pretending to be a player!

lines.zh: 你的血量很低，我可以吃了！
lines.en: Your health is low, I can eat you!
Follow me, you won't regret it!
You're my target, hurry!
Collision detected!
I wear your face, and the road parts.

lines.zh: 我的肩膀是借来的，很硬。
lines.en: This shoulder is borrowed. It's hard.
Get out of my way or you'll be in trouble!
We collided, what a surprise!
You fell down from my collision!
I rammed into you!
You flew away from my collision!
I deliberately collided with you!
We collided, what a surprise!
I found my mate!

lines.zh: 我穿着你的皮，你不认得我？
lines.en: I wear your skin. Don't you know me?

lines.zh: 找到你我真是太高兴了！
lines.en: Finding you makes me so happy!

lines.zh: 跟我回家，我给你看个东西。
lines.en: Come home with me. I'll show you something.
We protect each other!
Together, we're the same kind!
I'm so happy to find you!
We'll survive together!
Together, you're a zombie too!
Finding a companion makes me so excited!

lines.zh: 听到脚步声，它悄然移动。
lines.en: It moves silently at footsteps.
You turn, and it's behind you.
It pretends to be you, sneaking close.
You don't know if it's friend or foe.

lines.zh: 你转过身，它已近在咫尺。
lines.en: You turn, and it's almost there.
It suddenly appears in front of you.
It mimics your footsteps.

lines.zh: 你一转头，它已近在咫尺。
lines.en: You turn, and it's almost there.
It follows you silently.

lines.zh: 你突然发现它在你身边。
lines.en: You suddenly notice it beside you.

lines.zh: 我穿得和你一样，看清了。
lines.en: I dress just like you. Look closely.
It's spotted you.
It's approaching you.

lines.zh: 我穿着你的脸，站在门口。
lines.en: I wear your face and stand in the doorway.
It follows your footsteps.
It's tracking you.
It's focusing on you.
It's observing you.
I walk up wearing your face.
It's ready to jump on you.
It just walked out of your house.
It took your torch.
It remembers the road you took.

lines.zh: 你的名字被它念了一遍。
lines.en: It says your name once.
It stood by your bed a long while.

lines.zh: 你靠近它时，它突然惊跳。
lines.en: It jumps when you approach.
It stares at you for a while.
My face is exactly like yours.

lines.zh: 我站在你身后，用你的姿势。
lines.en: I stand behind you wearing your posture.
It starts attacking you.
It follows your trail.
It's getting closer.
It seems to be waiting.
It suddenly turns to look at you.

lines.zh: 我学你抬手，这一下会用你的力道。
lines.en: I raise my arm the way you do, and strike with your own strength.
It wears your skin and copies your smile.
You cannot tell which one is you.
It counts the hearts you have left.
The story has reached this step.
It waits for you to turn and check.

lines.zh: 它复制你的护甲，也复制伤。
lines.en: It copies your armor, and your wounds.
Three endings. It wants yours.
The one behind you is the real it.
It opens its mouth, and your voice comes out.
Don't trust the person from a moment ago.

lines.zh: 发出低沉咆哮，向你逼近。
lines.en: Growls lowly and approaches you.
Fakes as a player, then attacks suddenly.

lines.zh: 咬向你的脸，试图把你吓跑。
lines.en: Bites at your face, trying to scare you off.

lines.zh: 挥舞着腐烂的手臂，试图击倒你。
lines.en: Swings its rotting arms to knock you down.

lines.zh: 伸出长舌头，试图舔你的脸。
lines.en: Extends its long tongue to lick your face.

lines.zh: 发出嘶嘶声，试图吸引你的注意。
lines.en: Whispers, trying to catch your attention.
Hits you with its decayed hide.
Sprays you with foul saliva.

lines.zh: 用腐烂的手指勾引你靠近。
lines.en: Dangles its decayed fingers to draw you in.

lines.zh: 发出呜咽声，试图让你同情。
lines.en: Sobs to try and elicit pity from you.
It swings with your own motion.
That claw. You know the technique.
Under the skin, the same teeth.
It grabs the strap of your pack.
It breathes at your ear.
For a moment, you slapped yourself.

lines.zh: 在夜晚从远处缓缓浮现。
lines.en: Appears slowly from afar at night.

lines.zh: 从坟墓中爬出，向你逼近。
lines.en: Crawls out of a grave and approaches you.

lines.zh: 在废弃的建筑中突然出现。
lines.en: Spawns suddenly in a dilapidated building.

lines.zh: 从密林深处的洞穴中走出。
lines.en: Walks out from a cave in the deep forest.
Spawns on a decayed grass block.
Appears in a dark graveyard.

lines.zh: 在废弃的村庄中突然出现。
lines.en: Spawns suddenly in a deserted village.

lines.zh: 从远处的洞穴中缓缓走出。
lines.en: Walks out of a distant cave.
Spawns on a desolate hill.
Spawns on the edge of the forest.
Event sixteen begins.
Someone wearing your face stands at the door.

lines.zh: 剧情走到这一步，它来了。
lines.en: The story reaches here, and it arrives.
It steps into the light from behind you.
This shell was a zombie once.
It imitates far too well.
Burned by fire!
It falls like you, very convincingly.
Underwater, its eyes stay open.
The skin burns off and half its face shows.
The arrow lands and it makes no sound.
The spell grazes it and the skin ripples.
It is hungry, but it does not eat.
The lightning shows its real face.
Falling into the void, it still smiles.
